Husband Kills Wife in Separate Incidents; One Surrenders to Police

In Hardoi, a husband allegedly killed his wife with an axe after seeing her with another man, subsequently surrendering to the police. In a separate incident, a husband reportedly took his own life after his wife's taunts, with the wife having been living at her parental home for four months. Another report details a wife who had previously informed her father of her fear that her husband would kill her, before being killed by him with 11 axe blows.
